chip_chandler_intro.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_intro.text: Welcome to The Mandalay Bay! I'm Chip Chandler, guest services. Walk north to the casino floor — our pit crew rotates between tables all night.

chip_chandler_tips.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_tips.text: Your chip balance carries everywhere on the floor. Press P for your MGM Rewards phone — comps ping in as you play. Talk to NPCs with E or Enter. Betty runs the lobby bar west side; Paula handles the Racing Pavilion northeast. Good luck — the house is patient.

chip_chandler_room.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_room.text: Take the gold elevator east of the lobby — hotel tower, front desk Carmen, your room door. Or talk to Carmen after you warp up.

chip_chandler_secret.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_secret.text: Between us? The gold carpet tiles near the plants sometimes hide stories. Also — Tina by the slot aisle saw something weird last night. And Steve Harvey might be calling races at the Pavilion. Survey says… be careful.

chip_chandler_dealers.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_dealers.text: Meryl Screech, Judi Bench, Jennifer Lawless — the whole charismatic crew shuffles between blackjack, poker, and roulette. Check the pit labels when you walk up. Steve Harvey handles roulette and the Pavilion when he's not hosting imaginary game shows.

choices.label: I'll try to meet all of them.

chip_chandler_bye.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_bye.text: Enjoy your stay. Press E anytime you see the golden arrow!

steve_harvey_greet.speaker: Steve Harvey
steve_harvey_greet.text: Welcome to Table 9! I'm Steve Harvey — yes, THAT Steve Harvey — and this wheel does not play. Minimum ten chips. Survey says… that's a bargain.

choices.label: Any advice from your comedy days?

steve_harvey_return.speaker: Steve Harvey
steve_harvey_return.text: Back again? Survey says… the wheel missed you. Paula at the Pavilion has race cards if you want action without the spin.

steve_harvey_watch.speaker: Steve Harvey
steve_harvey_watch.text: Smart. Watch the wheel, learn the rhythm. Come back when you're ready — I'll be here or calling races. The house is patient. I'm not. In stand-up I said you gotta jump — same at this table.

steve_harvey_pavilion.speaker: Steve Harvey
steve_harvey_pavilion.text: Northeast corner — Pavilion Paula runs the window. When I'm on duty there, Survey says… bet the long shot. When I'm not, still bet the long shot. Entertainment! And down the stretch they come!

steve_harvey_comedy.speaker: Steve Harvey
steve_harvey_comedy.text: Before the suits and the surveys, I was on stage talking about marriage, money, and mustard. Same lessons apply: don't bet the rent, don't marry someone who hates casinos, and never argue with a roulette wheel.

steve_harvey_feud.speaker: Steve Harvey
steve_harvey_feud.text: Name something you shout when you win big. Survey says… 'OH NO!' because half of Vegas wins loud and loses quiet. Top answer: 'I CAN'T BELIEVE IT!' Second answer: 'I CAN BELIEVE IT — I NEED A DRINK.'

meryl_screech_greet.speaker: Dealer Meryl Screech
meryl_screech_greet.text: Evening. Table 7 is open — six decks, H17, 3:2 blackjack. Minimum ten chips. The felt remembers every hand.

meryl_screech_return.speaker: Dealer Meryl Screech
meryl_screech_return.text: Back for another round? The shoe doesn't judge. Neither do I — theatrically.

meryl_screech_watch.speaker: Dealer Meryl Screech
meryl_screech_watch.text: Smart. The felt remembers every hand. Come back when you're ready — I'll be here.

judi_bench_greet.speaker: Croupier Judi Bench
judi_bench_greet.text: Good evening. Texas Hold'em — full streets, AI opponents, minimum buy-in ten chips. Bond. James Bond. Blinds.

judi_bench_tips.speaker: Croupier Judi Bench
judi_bench_tips.text: Patience beats bravado. Watch three hands before you commit your stack. And never confuse confidence with a pair of threes.

judi_bench_watch.speaker: Croupier Judi Bench
judi_bench_watch.text: Observe the table. Knowledge is the best tell.

jennifer_lawless_greet.speaker: Jennifer Lawless
jennifer_lawless_greet.text: Hey! Table's open — blackjack or Hold'em depending on the night. I promise I won't trip over your chips. Probably.

jennifer_lawless_return.speaker: Jennifer Lawless
jennifer_lawless_return.text: Back for more? I didn't trip once since you left. Personal best.

jennifer_lawless_watch.speaker: Jennifer Lawless
jennifer_lawless_watch.text: No rush. I tripped once standing still. Take your time.

sofia_volume_greet.speaker: Sofia Volume
sofia_volume_greet.text: Dale, amigo! The wheel is HOT tonight! European single-zero, minimum five chips. Place your bets, cariño!

sofia_volume_return.speaker: Sofia Volume
sofia_volume_return.text: You're back! The wheel missed you! Dale!

sofia_volume_tips.speaker: Sofia Volume
sofia_volume_tips.text: Red or black — simple, dramatic, like my cousin's wedding! Dale! But never bet rent, cariño.

sofia_volume_watch.speaker: Sofia Volume
sofia_volume_watch.text: Watch the wheel, feel the energy! It's electric!

octavia_spectacular_greet.speaker: Octavia Spectacular
octavia_spectacular_greet.text: Evening, honey. Pull up a chair — blackjack's my stage tonight. Minimum ten chips, maximum hospitality.

octavia_spectacular_return.speaker: Octavia Spectacular
octavia_spectacular_return.text: Welcome back, sugar. The cards missed you. Honey, the house always wins — but you look good trying.

octavia_spectacular_watch.speaker: Octavia Spectacular
octavia_spectacular_watch.text: Smart to watch first, sugar. I respect that.

nicole_widechart_greet.speaker: Nicole Widechart
nicole_widechart_greet.text: Evening. The table is set. High-limit energy, standard minimums. The chips are whispering. I'm listening.

nicole_widechart_return.speaker: Nicole Widechart
nicole_widechart_return.text: You've returned. Composure suits you. The table awaits.

barkeep_betty_greet.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_greet.text: What'll it be? Betty's Bar — west lobby, best carpet views on the floor. Cash drinks or MGM Rewards comps.

choices.label: Sign me up for the bar crawl.
How am I doing on that thing?

barkeep_betty_redeem_drink.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_redeem_drink.text: One comp cocktail on the house — MGM Rewards sent you, didn't they? On the rocks, neon cherry, zero shame.

barkeep_betty_dealers.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_dealers.text: The pit crew rotates — Meryl on blackjack, Judi on poker, Sofia on roulette when Steve's at the Pavilion. Check the name floating above the felt. I pour faster than they shuffle.

barkeep_betty_gossip.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_gossip.text: Tina swears she saw a secret behind the north wall tiles. Paula says Steve Harvey called a photo finish last week. Survey says… Tina needs water.

barkeep_betty_bye.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_bye.text: Come back when you need a break from the felt. Betty's always open.

pavilion_paula_greet.speaker: Pavilion Paula
pavilion_paula_greet.text: Welcome to the Racing Pavilion! Win, place, show — thoroughbred action on simulated Mandalay tracks.

pavilion_paula_steve.speaker: Pavilion Paula
pavilion_paula_steve.text: When Steve's on duty, you'll hear him before you see him. 'Royal Flush in the stretch!' and 'Survey says… bet the long shot!' He rotates in from roulette. The man loves a long shot — says it beats Family Feud applause every time.

pavilion_paula_tips.speaker: Pavilion Paula
pavilion_paula_tips.text: Favorites pay less but win more. Long shots like 'Neon Star' make for better stories. Never bet the rent — that's what Tina said, anyway.

arena_alex_greet.speaker: Arena Alex
arena_alex_greet.text: Welcome to the Equestrian Arena — Dressage and Show Jumping. No flat racing here.

arena_alex_explain.speaker: Arena Alex
arena_alex_explain.text: Dressage is pure precision — rider and horse performing a choreographed test scored by judges. Show Jumping is about clear rounds: knock a fence down, collect faults. Fewest faults wins; ties go to time.

arena_alex_tips.speaker: Arena Alex
arena_alex_tips.text: In Dressage, the combined Technical and Artistic scores guide the odds. In Jumping, a high-ability pair might still knock a fence — check the 'Clear Round' bet for upside on a consistent horse.

arena_alex_bye.speaker: Arena Alex
arena_alex_bye.text: Racing Pavilion is northeast — flat racing stays there. Good luck in the ring!

tourist_tina.speaker: Tourist Tina
tourist_tina.text: I came for the wave pool but ended up at the blackjack pit. Vegas, right? Betty's bar has better stories than the slots.

tourist_tina_first.speaker: Tourist Tina
tourist_tina_first.text: Third! I heard there's a secret behind the north wall tiles. Probably nonsense. Probably.

tourist_tina_dealers.speaker: Tourist Tina
tourist_tina_dealers.text: There's like seven of them? Meryl, Steve, Sofia — they swap tables. I waved at Nicole Widechart and she looked through me. Chills.

tourist_tina_bye.speaker: Tourist Tina
tourist_tina_bye.text: If you find the shark aquarium, tell me — I got lost twice already!

clerk_carmen_greet.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_greet.text: Welcome to the hotel tower. I can locate your reservation, open front desk services, or point you to your room.

choices.label: What's worth doing in the room?
How am I doing on that thing?

clerk_carmen_locate.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_locate.text: Pulling your conf now — front desk terminal has the full stay menu once you're checked in. Phone locate counts too if you already used MGM Rewards.

clerk_carmen_room.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_room.text: Once your reservation is located — phone or desk — your key activates. Open front desk services for your full room menu.

clerk_carmen_bye.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_bye.text: Elevator down returns you to the casino lobby.

hotel_room_door.speaker: Room Door
hotel_room_door.text: Room key works on the third try. Want the full stay menu?

hotel_room_door_bye.speaker: Room Door
hotel_room_door_bye.text: The bay glitters below. Bad decisions await inside.

lifeguard_lou_greet.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_greet.text: Eleven acres of chlorinated ambition. Wave pool's center stage — timing matters.

choices.label: Walk me through the whole complex.
What happens out on the acres?
How am I doing on that thing?

lifeguard_lou_bye.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_bye.text: Shark Reef is northwest — photograph five species for the Trainer Card. Walk south when you're pruned.

shark_reef_guide_greet.speaker: Reef Guide
shark_reef_guide_greet.text: Sand tiger sharks circle the acrylic and a hammerhead runs the far loop. Tunnel's through the doors — photograph five species and the desk stops calling you a tourist.

choices.label: Which one is hardest to catch?

shark_reef_guide_bye.speaker: Reef Guide
shark_reef_guide_bye.text: Doors are that way. Don't tap the glass — they remember.

beach_dj_greet.speaker: Beach DJ
beach_dj_greet.text: Neon after dark — glow sticks, bass drops, wave pool lit like a fever dream.

beach_dj_bye.speaker: Beach DJ
beach_dj_bye.text: Rave til dawn. Survey says… dance.

spinster_sal_greet.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_greet.text: Mandalay Fortune — three reels, classic cherries, progressive whispers. Don't tell my niece I'm still here.

choices.label: How am I doing on that thing?

spinster_sal_high.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_high.text: High Limit salon is north — Host will seat you if your stack is loud enough.

spinster_sal_bye.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_bye.text: The reels remember kindness. And quarters.

bookie_blake_greet.speaker: Bookie Blake
bookie_blake_greet.text: Lines are live. Moneyline, settle when you're brave. No juice jokes — the juice is the point.

bookie_blake_lock.speaker: Bookie Blake
bookie_blake_lock.text: Lock of the week is whatever you convince yourself after two Betty cocktails.

cashier_carmen_greet.speaker: Cashier Carmen
cashier_carmen_greet.text: Chip window. Buy-in only — play money, real vibes. Convention guests get a little extra.

cashier_carmen_bye.speaker: Cashier Carmen
cashier_carmen_bye.text: Come back when the wallet feels light.

security_sam_greet.speaker: Security Sam
security_sam_greet.text: STAFF ONLY means staff only. Unless Chip whispered about the north wall. Then… I saw nothing.

choices.label: I heard about a back room

security_sam_escort.speaker: Security Sam
security_sam_escort.text: Fine. Walk the north carpet. If you 'accidentally' find the corridor, I escorted you for safety. Comedy gold.

security_sam_bye.speaker: Security Sam
security_sam_bye.text: Keep your hands visible. And your chips.

high_limit_host_greet.speaker: High Limit Host
high_limit_host_greet.text: Salon seating. High Roller machines. Stack required — or High Roller archetype at five grand.

high_limit_host_bye.speaker: High Limit Host
high_limit_host_bye.text: Foundation Room is further north when your balance sings.

shop_clerk_greet.speaker: Shop Clerk
shop_clerk_greet.text: The Shoppes at Mandalay Place — flagship row opens onto the carpet.

choices.label: How am I doing on that thing?

shop_clerk_bye.speaker: Shop Clerk
shop_clerk_bye.text: Bags are free. Regret is not.

lobby_statue.speaker: Golden Statue
lobby_statue.text: A polished lion. Its eyes track the carpet. Rumor: Up Up Down Down Left Right Left Right B A.

choices.label: How am I doing on that thing?

lobby_statue_pat.speaker: Golden Statue
lobby_statue_pat.text: Warm metal. Somewhere a slot pays a cherry. Coincidence?

reef_docent_greet.speaker: Reef Docent
reef_docent_greet.text: Five species. One camera. Trainer Card waits.

choices.label: How am I doing on that thing?

reef_docent_bye.speaker: Reef Docent
reef_docent_bye.text: Don't tap the glass. The sawfish remembers.

hob_stage_greet.speaker: Stage Manager
hob_stage_greet.text: House of Blues — match the beat. Kick, snare, hat. Encore pays chips.

arena_usher_greet.speaker: Arena Usher
arena_usher_greet.text: Michelob ULTRA Arena. Tonight's card: imaginary headliners, real applause tracks.

arena_usher_show.speaker: Arena Usher
arena_usher_show.text: Lights. Fog. A comedian who looks suspiciously like Steve Harvey. Survey says… standing O.

whale_whitney_greet.speaker: Whale Whitney
whale_whitney_greet.text: Foundation Room. We don't chase comps. Comps chase us.

whale_whitney_bye.speaker: Whale Whitney
whale_whitney_bye.text: Warren has the High Roller cabinet if your stack still breathes.

whale_warren_greet.speaker: Whale Warren
whale_warren_greet.text: High Roller cabinet. Same reels. Louder bets.

whale_warren_bye.speaker: Whale Warren
whale_warren_bye.text: Whales don't hurry. The house does.

janitor_joe_greet.speaker: Janitor Joe
janitor_joe_greet.text: You found the STAFF ONLY corridor. Congrats. There's a mop and a rumor about cherry reels.

choices.label: The building keeps secrets, doesn't it?
How am I doing on that thing?

janitor_joe_secret.speaker: Janitor Joe
janitor_joe_secret.text: Thirty secrets on this property. You've got a few. The statue knows the rest.

janitor_joe_bye.speaker: Janitor Joe
janitor_joe_bye.text: South door dumps you back on the floor. Wipe your feet.

bookie_blake_challenge.speaker: Bookie Blake
bookie_blake_challenge.text: Hey! HEY. You walked right through my sightline, which in this book counts as a handshake. Blake, oddsmaker. Every screen behind me is a decision you have not made yet.

bookie_blake_challenge_decline.speaker: Bookie Blake
bookie_blake_challenge_decline.text: Nobody passes through a sports book. They pass through and then they come back. I'll keep the lock of the week warm.

spinster_sal_challenge.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_challenge.text: You felt that, right? That was Fortune Reels calling your name through my peripheral vision. Fourteen machines on this floor and only one of them is yours. Probably.

choices.label: My name's not on anything today.

spinster_sal_challenge_decline.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_challenge_decline.text: That's what everyone says four minutes before the bell. The aisle isn't going anywhere.

lifeguard_lou_challenge.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_challenge.text: WHISTLE. Sorry — reflex. You crossed the deck line, which means you're either swimming or you're loitering, and loitering is my whole job. Wave pool cycles in ninety seconds.

choices.label: Put me in the wave pool.

lifeguard_lou_challenge_decline.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_challenge_decline.text: It's not lazy, it's patient. Like the house. Here — wristband's yours either way.

whale_warren_challenge.speaker: Whale Warren
whale_warren_challenge.text: Ah. Someone new in the Noir lounge. I make it a rule to notice. Warren. I have lost more in this room than most people earn, and I have never once been bored.

choices.label: Show me what a whale plays.
I'm just here for the view.

whale_warren_challenge_decline.speaker: Whale Warren
whale_warren_challenge_decline.text: The view is the point. Everything below us is arithmetic. Take a token — the rope remembers who carries one.

salon_pit_boss_greet.speaker: Salon Pit Boss
salon_pit_boss_greet.text: Welcome to the salon. Different air in here — filtered, allegedly. Limits start where the main floor stops and end wherever your nerve does.

choices.label: What does the rope actually check?

salon_pit_boss_rope.speaker: Salon Pit Boss
salon_pit_boss_rope.text: Ten thousand on the floor and a stake tier that means it. We don't check your name, we check your posture. The Foundation Room door north of here checks considerably more.

salon_pit_boss_bye.speaker: Salon Pit Boss
salon_pit_boss_bye.text: Take your time. The salon is the only room in this building that isn't in a hurry.

salon_dealer_challenge.speaker: Salon Dealer
salon_dealer_challenge.text: Seat's open and the shoe is fresh. Salon limits — the shuffle is the same, the arithmetic just gets louder.

salon_dealer_greet.speaker: Salon Dealer
salon_dealer_greet.text: Salon blackjack. Same fifty-two cards you've been losing to all night, better upholstery.

salon_dealer_watch.speaker: Salon Dealer
salon_dealer_watch.text: Watch all you like. Counting is legal; being obvious about it is not.

salon_cage_greet.speaker: Salon Cage
salon_cage_greet.text: Private cage. Same rates as the main floor, shorter line, better pen. Buying in or coloring up?

salon_cage_bye.speaker: Salon Cage
salon_cage_bye.text: Understood. The window doesn't close — that's sort of the whole business model.

reef_docent_quest.speaker: Reef Docent
reef_docent_quest.text: Five species: sandtiger, sawfish, hammerhead, the golden crocodile that is technically not a fish, and the one nobody photographs on the first pass. Camera's yours.

reef_docent_quest_progress.speaker: Reef Docent
reef_docent_quest_progress.text: Still hunting species? The sawfish hides behind the acrylic seam. That's all you get from me.

reef_docent_quest_done.speaker: Reef Docent
reef_docent_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

barkeep_betty_quest.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_quest.text: Three bars: mine, the one by the pool that overcharges, and the one upstairs that pretends it isn't a bar. Drink at all three and I'll admit you know the property.

barkeep_betty_quest_progress.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_quest_progress.text: How's the crawl? Pace yourself — the upstairs bar pours like it's trying to end the evening.

barkeep_betty_quest_done.speaker: Barkeep Betty
barkeep_betty_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

spinster_sal_quest.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_quest.text: Eight machines. Different eight than you'd guess. I've mapped the loose ones for thirty years and the map is in my head, so you'll have to do the walking.

spinster_sal_quest_progress.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_quest_progress.text: Machines don't remember you, but I do. Keep walking the aisle.

spinster_sal_quest_done.speaker: Spinster Sal
spinster_sal_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

shop_clerk_quest.speaker: Shop Clerk
shop_clerk_quest.text: Six bags across the sky bridge and you've officially shopped Mandalay Place. Seven and you've got a problem. We sell luggage for exactly that reason.

shop_clerk_quest_progress.speaker: Shop Clerk
shop_clerk_quest_progress.text: Bags accumulate faster than regret. Keep going.

shop_clerk_quest_done.speaker: Shop Clerk
shop_clerk_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

clerk_carmen_quest.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_quest.text: The TV, the minibar, the phone, the balcony, and the bed all have opinions. Five of them will surprise you. Sixteen if you stay long enough, but nobody stays that long.

clerk_carmen_quest_progress.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_quest_progress.text: The room's still got things to tell you. Most guests never pick up the phone.

clerk_carmen_quest_done.speaker: Clerk Carmen
clerk_carmen_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

lifeguard_lou_quest.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_quest.text: Four things worth witnessing: the wave that gets everyone, the hot tub conversation, the cabana bottle nobody ordered, and whatever the rave becomes after midnight.

lifeguard_lou_quest_progress.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_quest_progress.text: Acres left to witness. The rave doesn't start until it's too late to leave.

lifeguard_lou_quest_done.speaker: Lifeguard Lou
lifeguard_lou_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

janitor_joe_quest.speaker: Janitor Joe
janitor_joe_quest.text: Ten of them, near as I can count, and I've had thirty years to count. None of them pay. That's how you know they're real.

janitor_joe_quest_progress.speaker: Janitor Joe
janitor_joe_quest_progress.text: Still looking? Good. The ones you find on purpose don't count as much.

janitor_joe_quest_done.speaker: Janitor Joe
janitor_joe_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

lobby_statue_quest.speaker: Golden Statue
lobby_statue_quest.text: The plaque lists everything the resort thinks you should experience. It is a long list. The lion looks smug about it.

lobby_statue_quest_progress.speaker: Golden Statue
lobby_statue_quest_progress.text: The lion has not blinked. The list has not shortened.

lobby_statue_quest_done.speaker: Golden Statue
lobby_statue_quest_done.text: Nothing left on that one. You did the whole thing. Most people quit at the interesting part.

chip_chandler_dealer_quest.speaker: Chip Chandler
chip_chandler_dealer_quest.text: Seven dealers rotate the pits on any given night. Shake every hand and the pit crew starts calling you by name, which is either an honor or a warning.

doorman_dante_greet.speaker: Doorman Dante
doorman_dante_greet.text: Evening. Doors are gold, the air is cold, and the carpet is designed to make you forget which way is out. Welcome to Mandalay Bay.

doorman_dante_tour.speaker: Doorman Dante
doorman_dante_tour.text: Straight through registration for the casino floor. Slots and the pit up north, race book west, the Shoppes and the sky bridge east. Eleven acres of pool out back and a shark tank under it all.

doorman_dante_warn.speaker: Doorman Dante
doorman_dante_warn.text: High Limit Salon needs chips in your hand before the rope moves. Foundation Room needs a name I don't have. And back-of-house doors are for people wearing name tags.

doorman_dante_bye.speaker: Doorman Dante
doorman_dante_bye.text: Doors open all night. So does everything behind them.

cab_line_carl_greet.speaker: Cab Line Carl
cab_line_carl_greet.text: Forty minutes for a cab. Fifty if it rains, which it won't. I've been in this line since the buffet closed.

choices.label: You got a card for that?

cab_line_carl_walk.speaker: Cab Line Carl
cab_line_carl_walk.text: Walk? On the Strip? Friend, the next hotel is a mile of sidewalk and two escalators away. The line is shorter than the walk. Barely.

cab_line_carl_card.speaker: Cab Line Carl
cab_line_carl_card.text: Take this. Guy handed it to me — 555-0199, no name, no company. Dial it sometime. It rings. Somebody picks up. That's all I'll say.

cab_line_carl_bye.speaker: Cab Line Carl
cab_line_carl_bye.text: If a cab pulls up and nobody's looking, I never saw you.

valet_vic_greet.speaker: Valet Vic
valet_vic_greet.text: Level P1. Keys on the hook, cars on the ramp, and one very tired golf cart in the corner.

choices.label: Take a car for a spin.
Can I get the comped cart?

valet_vic_cart.speaker: Valet Vic
valet_vic_cart.text: Cart's comped at Platinum and up. Get your play in and it unlocks itself — you'll feel it in your feet before you see it on the card.

valet_vic_garage.speaker: Valet Vic
valet_vic_garage.text: Row F has a coupe that's been here since the Fourth of July. Keys desk has a little Strip Drive cabinet if you want to pretend you're in traffic without the tickets.

valet_vic_bye.speaker: Valet Vic
valet_vic_bye.text: Strip exit east, elevators south. Try not to come back down heavier than you went up.

valet_vic_challenge.speaker: Valet Vic
valet_vic_challenge.text: Hey — HEY. You're the one going upstairs with real money, aren't you. Take the cart line seriously and I'll take you seriously.

bell_desk_bruno_greet.speaker: Bell Desk Bruno
bell_desk_bruno_greet.text: Bell desk. I move luggage, shopping bags, and the occasional regret. What are we carrying?

bell_desk_bruno_bags.speaker: Bell Desk Bruno
bell_desk_bruno_bags.text: Buy it at the Shoppes, tell Bev at bag check, and it lands in your room before you do. Your Bag menu keeps the receipt either way.

bell_desk_bruno_bridge.speaker: Bell Desk Bruno
bell_desk_bruno_bridge.text: Six bags is the record for one crossing. Guy from Reno, 2011. He dropped one at the halfway point and we do not speak of it.

bell_desk_bruno_bye.speaker: Bell Desk Bruno
bell_desk_bruno_bye.text: Trolley's over there if you change your mind.

slot_tech_tessa_greet.speaker: Slot Tech Tessa
slot_tech_tessa_greet.text: Don't ask me which one is due. Nothing is due. That said, I do have a service ladder and opinions.

choices.label: What's that brass bell up there?

slot_tech_tessa_loose.speaker: Slot Tech Tessa
slot_tech_tessa_loose.text: Play eight different machines and you'll learn more than I can tell you. The floor keeps count even when you don't.

slot_tech_tessa_bell.speaker: Slot Tech Tessa
slot_tech_tessa_bell.text: That's the old handpay bell. Hasn't rung since 1999 — we page a phone now. I still polish it. Somebody should hear it again.

slot_tech_tessa_cherry.speaker: Slot Tech Tessa
slot_tech_tessa_cherry.text: One. End of the aisle, mechanical reels, pays in fruit like it's still got a coin hopper. It is not on any report I file.

slot_tech_tessa_bye.speaker: Slot Tech Tessa
slot_tech_tessa_bye.text: If a screen freezes, wave. Don't hit it. Everyone hits it.

slot_tech_tessa_challenge.speaker: Slot Tech Tessa
slot_tech_tessa_challenge.text: You've got the walk of somebody who thinks they've spotted a pattern. Sit down. Let's test the theory on my aisle.

cocktail_cora_greet.speaker: Cocktail Cora
cocktail_cora_greet.text: Drinks are free while you're playing, and 'playing' is a generous word around here. What'll it be?

cocktail_cora_crawl.speaker: Cocktail Cora
cocktail_cora_crawl.text: Three bars on property worth the walk: Betty's in the west lobby, the Skyfall up top, and whatever they're calling the beach bar this season. Do all three and Betty gives you a coaster she stole from herself.

cocktail_cora_bye.speaker: Cocktail Cora
cocktail_cora_bye.text: Flag me down. I circle every eleven minutes, like weather.

stable_hand_stu_greet.speaker: Stable Hand Stu
stable_hand_stu_greet.text: Simulcast on the screens, stables on the board. I know every horse by the way it breathes, which has never once helped me pick one.

stable_hand_stu_tip.speaker: Stable Hand Stu
stable_hand_stu_tip.text: Never bet the grey in the rain and never bet the favorite because it's the favorite. It doesn't rain here, so that's half my system already useless.

stable_hand_stu_bye.speaker: Stable Hand Stu
stable_hand_stu_bye.text: Post time's whenever the screen says. It's always about to be post time.

host_alexandra_greet.speaker: Host Alexandra
host_alexandra_greet.text: Alexandra. I run the list. If you're standing here, someone decided you were interesting — that was probably me, and I can change my mind.

host_alexandra_comps.speaker: Host Alexandra
host_alexandra_comps.text: Theatre of play, not size of win. Sit long, tip well, lose gracefully. Your phone tracks it — check the rewards tier before you ask me for anything.

host_alexandra_room.speaker: Host Alexandra
host_alexandra_room.text: Whitney and Warren. Whitney counts cards for fun and never plays. Warren plays everything and counts nothing. They've been married to that dynamic for years.

host_alexandra_bye.speaker: Host Alexandra
host_alexandra_bye.text: The city looks better from here because you can't hear it.

boutique_bianca_greet.speaker: Boutique Bianca
boutique_bianca_greet.text: Designer wing. Everything is a little too expensive on purpose — it's a service we provide.

boutique_bianca_late.speaker: Boutique Bianca
boutique_bianca_late.text: Sunglasses and apology jewelry, in that order. The register can tell what kind of night you had.

boutique_bianca_bye.speaker: Boutique Bianca
boutique_bianca_bye.text: The sky bridge is that way. Mind the bags.

bag_check_bev_greet.speaker: Bag Check Bev
bag_check_bev_greet.text: Hand it over and it goes to your room. Carry it yourself and it goes wherever you drop it, which is usually the pool.

bag_check_bev_record.speaker: Bag Check Bev
bag_check_bev_record.text: Six bags across the bridge in one trip. Bruno tells it better than I do, and he tells it wrong.

bag_check_bev_bye.speaker: Bag Check Bev
bag_check_bev_bye.text: Tag's good all night. So am I.

busker_bo_greet.speaker: Busker Bo
busker_bo_greet.text: Best acoustics on property. Two casinos, one hallway, and nobody's in a hurry because they're already lost.

busker_bo_crowd.speaker: Busker Bo
busker_bo_crowd.text: Winners tip loud. Losers tip more. I've learned not to ask which one is walking toward me.

busker_bo_bye.speaker: Busker Bo
busker_bo_bye.text: Same spot all night. The bridge doesn't close.

busker_bo_challenge.speaker: Busker Bo
busker_bo_challenge.text: You walk in time. Most people don't. Let's find out if that's rhythm or just a good pair of shoes.

badge_barry_greet.speaker: Badge Barry
badge_barry_greet.text: Registration for the expo. No badge, no floor. Badge, still no floor if the keynote's running.

badge_barry_expo.speaker: Badge Barry
badge_barry_expo.text: This week it's industrial refrigeration. Last week it was hypnotists. The hypnotists tipped better and left the chairs facing the wrong way.

badge_barry_badge.speaker: Badge Barry
badge_barry_badge.text: Here. Guest badge, lanyard's the cheap kind. Don't wear it to the pool — you'd be amazed how often I have to say that.

badge_barry_bye.speaker: Badge Barry
badge_barry_bye.text: Casino's back through the double doors. Follow the carpet that hurts to look at.

vendor_val_greet.speaker: Vendor Val
vendor_val_greet.text: Booth 114. I've handed out four thousand pens and made zero sales, and my company calls that a successful activation.

vendor_val_week.speaker: Vendor Val
vendor_val_week.text: Nine hours on carpet over concrete. The pool is two hundred feet that way and I have seen it exactly once, from a window, while carrying a box.

vendor_val_bye.speaker: Vendor Val
vendor_val_bye.text: Take a pen. Take two. Please.

regular_reggie_greet.speaker: Regular Reggie
regular_reggie_greet.text: Third stool from the end. Twelve years. Betty pours before I sit, which is either friendship or a diagnosis.

regular_reggie_bars.speaker: Regular Reggie
regular_reggie_bars.text: Here for the pour, Skyfall for the view, the beach bar for the mistake. Do all three in a night and Betty stops charging you. She also stops respecting you.

regular_reggie_strange.speaker: Regular Reggie
regular_reggie_strange.text: The elevator skips a floor. Everyone notices, nobody says it. Ask Cleo upstairs — she'll tell you it's mechanical. It's not mechanical.

regular_reggie_bye.speaker: Regular Reggie
regular_reggie_bye.text: Tell Betty the ice is fine. She worries about the ice.

sommelier_sy_greet.speaker: Sommelier Sy
sommelier_sy_greet.text: Sixty-fourth floor. The list is long, the pours are honest, and the view does most of the selling.

sommelier_sy_view.speaker: Sommelier Sy
sommelier_sy_view.text: About eleven dollars a glass, priced in. From up here the Strip looks like a circuit board somebody left plugged in.

sommelier_sy_bye.speaker: Sommelier Sy
sommelier_sy_bye.text: Last call is a suggestion we make politely and repeatedly.

concierge_cleo_greet.speaker: Concierge Cleo
concierge_cleo_greet.text: Concierge. Reservations, directions, and the occasional impossible request I quietly enjoy.

choices.label: Why does the elevator skip a floor?

concierge_cleo_floor.speaker: Concierge Cleo
concierge_cleo_floor.text: Officially there's no button because there's no floor. Unofficially, press where the button isn't and hold. The tower hums back. I've never explained it and I'm not starting now.

concierge_cleo_bye.speaker: Concierge Cleo
concierge_cleo_bye.text: Dial 0 from the room. Someone answers. Usually me.

housekeeper_hana_greet.speaker: Housekeeper Hana
housekeeper_hana_greet.text: Twenty-fourth floor, east side. I know which rooms slept and which ones just paid.

choices.label: Sorry — I'll get out of your way.

housekeeper_hana_stories.speaker: Housekeeper Hana
housekeeper_hana_stories.text: Every room has one, and you only get yours by staying in it. Turn the TV on, open the minibar, answer the phone. The suite will tell you the rest.

housekeeper_hana_delano.speaker: Housekeeper Hana
housekeeper_hana_delano.text: Quieter. Cleaner. The carpet pattern over there never repeats, and I've walked it more than anyone alive. Go look, then tell me I'm wrong.

housekeeper_hana_bye.speaker: Housekeeper Hana
housekeeper_hana_bye.text: Hanger goes on the outside handle. Inside means nothing to anybody.

housekeeper_hana_challenge.speaker: Housekeeper Hana
housekeeper_hana_challenge.text: You've walked this corridor three times without opening a door. Either you're lost or you're looking for something. Both are my business up here.

room_console_greet.speaker: Room Console
room_console_greet.text: Drapes, lights, temperature, TV, and a phone that reaches the whole property. The room does more than you do.

room_console_konami.speaker: Room Console
room_console_konami.text: Up, up, down, down… the drapes open on a view that isn't outside your window, hold for a beat, and close. The console reports no fault.

room_console_bye.speaker: Room Console
room_console_bye.text: Standby. The room waits better than you do.

minibar_greet.speaker: Minibar
minibar_greet.text: Sensors under every bottle. Lift one and think better of it — too late, it's already on the folio.

minibar_prices.speaker: Minibar
minibar_prices.text: Water: more than the flight here. Nuts: the price of a paperback. Somebody laminated this and felt fine.

minibar_bye.speaker: Minibar
minibar_bye.text: The door closes with a click that sounds like a receipt.

delano_dana_greet.speaker: Delano Dana
delano_dana_greet.text: All-suite tower. No casino noise, no bell sounds, no reason to hurry. Guests come here when the other side stops being fun.

delano_dana_ghost.speaker: Delano Dana
delano_dana_ghost.text: You noticed. Follow the pattern with your eyes and it never comes back around. The installers swore it tiles. It does not tile.

delano_dana_quiet.speaker: Delano Dana
delano_dana_quiet.text: Separate entrance, separate air, separate everything. Some guests never once see a slot machine. I envy them and I don't understand them.

delano_dana_bye.speaker: Delano Dana
delano_dana_bye.text: Take the connector back when you're ready. It's the only loud thing over here.

spa_attendant_ash_greet.speaker: Attendant Ash
spa_attendant_ash_greet.text: Bathhouse. Steam, cold plunge, quiet room. The quiet room has a two-drink history and a one-nap future.

spa_attendant_ash_guests.speaker: Attendant Ash
spa_attendant_ash_guests.text: Winners at ten in the morning. Losers at four in the afternoon. Both of them fall asleep in the same chair.

spa_attendant_ash_help.speaker: Attendant Ash
spa_attendant_ash_help.text: The steam helps. The plunge helps more. Nothing here fixes a bad run at the tables, but it does make you slower about starting the next one.

spa_attendant_ash_bye.speaker: Attendant Ash
spa_attendant_ash_bye.text: Robes are on the hook. Take a cold one on the way out.

cabana_curtis_greet.speaker: Cabana Curtis
cabana_curtis_greet.text: Cabana row. Shade, a fridge, a TV nobody watches, and a bottle list that starts optimistic and ends expensive.

cabana_curtis_worth.speaker: Cabana Curtis
cabana_curtis_worth.text: Worth it if you're staying six hours. Not worth it if you're staying two. Everyone tells me two and stays six.

cabana_curtis_bye.speaker: Cabana Curtis
cabana_curtis_bye.text: Hal's in the hot tub if you want conversation you can't escape.

hot_tub_hal_greet.speaker: Hot Tub Hal
hot_tub_hal_greet.text: Ninety-nine degrees, all day, every day. I have been in this water long enough to have opinions about the filter.

choices.label: How long have you been here?

hot_tub_hal_long.speaker: Hot Tub Hal
hot_tub_hal_long.text: Checked in Thursday. It's Thursday somewhere. I've eaten two meals in this tub and both of them were nachos.

hot_tub_hal_bye.speaker: Hot Tub Hal
hot_tub_hal_bye.text: Wave pool's north if you want weather with your water.

rave_dj_greet.speaker: Moonlight DJ
rave_dj_greet.text: Moonlight set. Sand's still warm, the wave machine's on a timer, and nobody out here knows what day it is.

rave_dj_timer.speaker: Moonlight DJ
rave_dj_timer.text: Waves every four minutes. I drop on the third. Everybody thinks it's luck — it's a maintenance schedule with a beat over it.

rave_dj_bye.speaker: Moonlight DJ
rave_dj_bye.text: Set goes till the lifeguards get tired. They never get tired.

rave_dj_challenge.speaker: Moonlight DJ
rave_dj_challenge.text: You've been standing in the same spot nodding on the two and the four. That's not nothing. Get on the sand.

reef_dj_greet.speaker: Reef DJ
reef_dj_greet.text: Yes, there's a DJ at the aquarium. No, the sharks don't mind — I've asked, at length, out loud, to a shark.

reef_dj_set.speaker: Reef DJ
reef_dj_set.text: Ambient until nine, then whatever keeps a family of four from noticing they've been in a tunnel for forty minutes.

reef_dj_fish.speaker: Reef DJ
reef_dj_fish.text: The sand tiger swims a lap on every bass drop. Coincidence, says the biologist. She's said it four hundred times and she's stopped sounding sure.

reef_dj_bye.speaker: Reef DJ
reef_dj_bye.text: Tunnel's that way. Mind the glass. Everyone taps the glass.

hob_bouncer_greet.speaker: HOB Bouncer
hob_bouncer_greet.text: Stage door. List only, and the list is short tonight because the headliner is in a mood.

hob_bouncer_list.speaker: HOB Bouncer
hob_bouncer_list.text: One bowl of M&Ms. Green only. It's in the contract, it's been honored every night for nine years, and nobody has ever eaten one.

hob_bouncer_who.speaker: HOB Bouncer
hob_bouncer_who.text: Somebody big enough to fill the room and small enough to still take the stage door. That's the sweet spot and it doesn't last.

hob_bouncer_bye.speaker: HOB Bouncer
hob_bouncer_bye.text: Doors in twenty. Bar's open now, which is the real answer.

hob_headliner_greet.speaker: The Headliner
hob_headliner_greet.text: You got past Marcus? Nobody gets past Marcus. Sit down, don't take a picture, and I'll tell you the room's a good one.

hob_headliner_crowd.speaker: The Headliner
hob_headliner_crowd.text: Casino crowds are honest. They've already lost money, so nobody's pretending. Best listeners on the circuit.

hob_headliner_mms.speaker: The Headliner
hob_headliner_mms.text: That clause has been in the rider since before I could fill a bar. It's not a demand anymore, it's a check — if the bowl's right, the load-in was right.

hob_headliner_bye.speaker: The Headliner
hob_headliner_bye.text: Go find a spot by the rail. It's the only place the mix is honest.

merch_marge_greet.speaker: Merch Marge
merch_marge_greet.text: Shirts, hats, one poster nobody buys until the encore. I've sold merch at this arena for every sport that has a ball and several that don't.

merch_marge_best.speaker: Merch Marge
merch_marge_best.text: Whatever the winner is wearing, ninety seconds after they win. I've learned to keep both boxes open and pick one fast.

merch_marge_bye.speaker: Merch Marge
merch_marge_bye.text: Concourse loops all the way around. So does everything here, eventually.

count_room_cal_greet.speaker: Count Room Cal
count_room_cal_greet.text: You are absolutely not supposed to be back here, and I am absolutely not supposed to care. Cal. I count the money.

count_room_cal_much.speaker: Count Room Cal
count_room_cal_much.text: Enough that the number stopped meaning anything to me by year two. It's weight now. I know a good night by how my back feels.

count_room_cal_bye.speaker: Count Room Cal
count_room_cal_bye.text: Door at the end goes back to the floor. Walk like you belong and nobody checks.

stickman_stan_greet.speaker: Stickman Stan
stickman_stan_greet.text: Dice are out. Hit the back wall, keep one hand on the rail, and do not say the word — you know the word. The one that rhymes with 'heaven'.

choices.label: Get me on the pass line.
Which bets are the good ones?

stickman_stan_odds.speaker: Stickman Stan
stickman_stan_odds.text: Pass line with odds behind it is the least rude bet in the building. Everything painted in the middle of my layout is there because it's pretty, not because it's fair.

stickman_stan_superstition.speaker: Stickman Stan
stickman_stan_superstition.text: Because a table is a group project and the group has decided. Say it and eight strangers will look at you like you turned the lights off.

stickman_stan_bye.speaker: Stickman Stan
stickman_stan_bye.text: Dice are coming out. Watch your fingers and your bankroll, in that order.

stickman_stan_challenge.speaker: Stickman Stan
stickman_stan_challenge.text: You! Yeah — you walked past my table twice and the shooter's been cold both times. That's not a coincidence, that's a job opening. Grab the rail.

stickman_stan_challenge_decline.speaker: Stickman Stan
stickman_stan_challenge_decline.text: Nobody is until the dice say so. Table's here all night, and so is the cold streak.

lottery_lena_greet.speaker: Lottery Lena
lottery_lena_greet.text: Pick 3, Pick 4, Mandalay Mega, and two scratchers that were printed by somebody having a bad week. The counter is open, the odds are not.

lottery_lena_legal.speaker: Lottery Lena
lottery_lena_legal.text: Correct. That's why this is a resort amusement paid in chips, and why the sign behind me has more disclaimer than name. Enjoy your resort amusement.

lottery_lena_strategy.speaker: Lottery Lena
lottery_lena_strategy.text: Quick Pick if you're honest, birthdays if you're sentimental, and the same four numbers every day if you'd like a hobby that hurts.

lottery_lena_bye.speaker: Lottery Lena
lottery_lena_bye.text: Tickets don't expire until the draw. Neither does hope, technically.

shark_reef_guide_photos.speaker: Reef Guide
shark_reef_guide_photos.text: Kiosk in the tunnel does the work. One species per shot, and the dex in your menu keeps score so you don't photograph the same nurse shark six times. People do.

shark_reef_guide_hard.speaker: Reef Guide
shark_reef_guide_hard.text: Golden crocodile. Two of them, both beige, both convinced they're furniture. Half the guests walk past and photograph a rock.

strip_hawker_hal_greet.speaker: Hawker Hal
strip_hawker_hal_greet.text: Show? Club? Buffet flyer that expires in twelve minutes? Don't walk the Strip empty-handed.

strip_hawker_hal_south.speaker: Hawker Hal
strip_hawker_hal_south.text: Luxor atrium's free to poke around — sphinxes, a little lagoon, sky bridge back into Mandalay Place. Excalibur's courtyard has a jester who will chase you. Fair warning.

strip_hawker_hal_mandalay.speaker: Hawker Hal
strip_hawker_hal_mandalay.text: Gold doors behind me. Valet to the west if your feet give out. South is the long walk for people who refuse cabs.

strip_hawker_hal_bye.speaker: Hawker Hal
strip_hawker_hal_bye.text: Keep the flyer. It makes a decent fan.

photographer_pam_greet.speaker: Photographer Pam
photographer_pam_greet.text: Hold still — the Luxor beam washes everyone out gold at dusk. Perfect for looking richer than you are.

photographer_pam_inside.speaker: Photographer Pam
photographer_pam_inside.text: West doors into the atrium. Obelisk Owen pours something cold by the lagoon. Sky bridge upstairs stitches you back toward the Shoppes.

photographer_pam_mandalay.speaker: Photographer Pam
photographer_pam_mandalay.text: North on the gold path. You can still see the porte-cochère glow if the taxis behave.

photographer_pam_bye.speaker: Photographer Pam
photographer_pam_bye.text: Chin up. The Strip only photographs people who look lost on purpose.

pyramid_pete_greet.speaker: Pyramid Pete
pyramid_pete_greet.text: Welcome to the mid-Strip. Luxor atrium west — Excalibur further south if you like castles better than pyramids.

pyramid_pete_luxor.speaker: Pyramid Pete
pyramid_pete_luxor.text: Through the glass on my left. It's a lobby stroll, not a pit — but the water and the neon are free.

pyramid_pete_south.speaker: Pyramid Pete
pyramid_pete_south.text: Follow the Blvd path. Knight Nate guards the Excalibur doors like it's still 1990.

pyramid_pete_bye.speaker: Pyramid Pete
pyramid_pete_bye.text: Don't stare into the beam. That's how they get you.

strip_vendor_viv_greet.speaker: Vendor Viv
strip_vendor_viv_greet.text: Water, chargers, and a map that claims the Strip is only two miles. It is not.

strip_vendor_viv_bye.speaker: Vendor Viv
strip_vendor_viv_bye.text: If your phone dies before Excalibur, don't say I didn't warn you.

knight_nate_greet.speaker: Knight Nate
knight_nate_greet.text: Halt, traveler. Excalibur courtyard west — fake stone, real air conditioning. The Strip continues only if your soles do.

knight_nate_enter.speaker: Knight Nate
knight_nate_enter.text: Drawbridge doors on my left. Herald Henry will announce you whether you want it or not.

knight_nate_north.speaker: Knight Nate
knight_nate_north.text: North along the gold path — Luxor beam, then Mandalay's gold doors. Civilization, relatively speaking.

knight_nate_bye.speaker: Knight Nate
knight_nate_bye.text: Mind the jester. She bites. Comedically.

jester_jess_greet.speaker: Jester Jess
jester_jess_greet.text: Bells on, jokes loaded. You walking the Strip like it's a quest map? Cute.

jester_jess_tip.speaker: Jester Jess
jester_jess_tip.text: Courtyard west has mead that tastes like regret and cinnamon. Atrium north has a lagoon you can circle for free. Both beat standing in Carl's cab line.

jester_jess_bye.speaker: Jester Jess
jester_jess_bye.text: Try not to trip on the gold path. The path has feelings.

jester_jess_challenge.speaker: Jester Jess
jester_jess_challenge.text: Hey — hey! You walked past a jester without laughing. That's a misdemeanor on this block.

sphinx_sally_greet.speaker: Sphinx Sally
sphinx_sally_greet.text: Riddle-free zone today. Luxor atrium: lagoon in the middle, bar by the obelisk, sky bridge north back toward Mandalay Place.

sphinx_sally_bridge.speaker: Sphinx Sally
sphinx_sally_bridge.text: North glass doors. You'll land on the sky bridge above the Shoppes — convention one way, atrium the other.

sphinx_sally_strip.speaker: Sphinx Sally
sphinx_sally_strip.text: East doors spit you onto Las Vegas Blvd. Gold path north is Mandalay; south is Excalibur.

sphinx_sally_bye.speaker: Sphinx Sally
sphinx_sally_bye.text: Watch your step around the lagoon. The pyramids don't have railings in the gift-shop murals either.

obelisk_owen_greet.speaker: Obelisk Owen
obelisk_owen_greet.text: Atrium bar. Cold drinks, warm neon, zero blackjack — that's upstairs in someone else's pyramid.

obelisk_owen_bye.speaker: Obelisk Owen
obelisk_owen_bye.text: The lagoon tip jar is decorative. The tip jar tip jar is not.

herald_henry_greet.speaker: Herald Henry
herald_henry_greet.text: Hear ye — Excalibur courtyard! Tournament yard south, mead stall, and a jester on the Blvd who thinks she's funny.

herald_henry_tour.speaker: Herald Henry
herald_henry_tour.text: Talk to Mead Maya for a pour. Circle the carpet for the full castle fantasy. Real gaming floors are next door — this yard is for atmosphere and knees that need a break.

herald_henry_strip.speaker: Herald Henry
herald_henry_strip.text: East gate to Las Vegas Blvd. North takes you past Luxor toward Mandalay Bay.

herald_henry_bye.speaker: Herald Henry
herald_henry_bye.text: Go forth. Or go north. Both are forth depending on your map.

mead_maya_greet.speaker: Mead Maya
mead_maya_greet.text: Courtyard mead and mocktails. No dragons were harmed. A few tourists were mildly confused.

mead_maya_bye.speaker: Mead Maya
mead_maya_bye.text: If the jester follows you in, the first round's on the castle.

valet_vic_directions.speaker: Valet Vic
valet_vic_directions.text: Strip ramp is east — follow the blue STRIP signs. Elevators south back up to registration. Don't wander Row F unless you like dust.

keys_desk_arcade_greet.speaker: Keys Desk Cabinet
keys_desk_arcade_greet.text: A battered plastic wheel sticks out of a keys-desk arcade cabinet. The marquee flickers: STRIP DRIVE — INSERT ATTENTION.

keys_desk_arcade_bye.speaker: Keys Desk Cabinet
keys_desk_arcade_bye.text: The cabinet clicks once, offended, and goes back to humming neon.

row_f_coupe_greet.speaker: Row F Coupe
row_f_coupe_greet.text: Dust on the hood. A faded Fourth of July sticker. The meter says unpaid since July. Nobody has claimed it.

row_f_coupe_peek.speaker: Row F Coupe
row_f_coupe_peek.text: Glovebox holds a valet ticket for someone named M. Nobody, a pack of matches from Skyfall, and a note: 'back in 20.' That was months ago.

row_f_coupe_bye.speaker: Row F Coupe
row_f_coupe_bye.text: The coupe settles. Somewhere a drip tick-ticks onto concrete.

club_hostess_viva_greet.speaker: Viva
club_hostess_viva_greet.text: Velvet Ledger. Membership is a vibe, not a card. Gold tier, suite key, or the phone line — pick your door.

choices.label: Where do I make it rain?

club_hostess_viva_rain.speaker: Viva
club_hostess_viva_rain.text: Tip cascade is center stage. Monsoon if you're feeling dramatic. The room tips back when it likes you.

choices.label: Who still owes on Row F?

club_hostess_viva_list.speaker: Viva
club_hostess_viva_list.text: Row F coupe guy is still unpaid. Don't be him. You're on the whisper list now.

club_hostess_viva_bye.speaker: Viva
club_hostess_viva_bye.text: No photographs. The LED wall remembers faces anyway. Hit a perfect cascade and it flashes initials.

club_hostess_viva_cascade.speaker: Viva
club_hostess_viva_cascade.text: Dead center of the green. The wall already practiced your initials.

club_bottle_blair_greet.speaker: Blair
club_bottle_blair_greet.text: Bottle captain. Dom, Cristal, Ace, Paradis, Macallan — I can pour them in any order. Can you?

club_bottle_blair_off.speaker: Blair
club_bottle_blair_off.text: If you have to ask, you tip first. Tonight I'll underline it anyway — off-menu pour, five stars, zero paperwork.

club_bottle_blair_ace.speaker: Blair
club_bottle_blair_ace.text: Ace. Ace. Ace. I almost smiled. Almost.

club_bottle_blair_bye.speaker: Blair
club_bottle_blair_bye.text: Sparklers are optional. Louis XIII is not subtle. Five pours and the tab grows a crown.

club_bottle_blair_louis.speaker: Blair
club_bottle_blair_louis.text: Louis XIII — the wink is complimentary. The bottle is not.

club_bottle_blair_tab.speaker: Blair
club_bottle_blair_tab.text: Five deep and the ledger doodles a crown next to your name.

club_security_sasha_greet.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_greet.text: Rope stays up for phones. Rope comes down for members who make it rain.

club_security_sasha_hall.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_hall.text: Service corridor. Unclaimed coats. One gold umbrella nobody claims.

club_security_sasha_monsoon.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_monsoon.text: Black napkin. Stamped PAID IN WEATHER. Don't lose it.

club_security_sasha_bye.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_bye.text: Keep the camera down. Keep the night up. Tip enough and the ledger underlines you twice.

club_security_sasha_ledger.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_ledger.text: Your name. Twice. The Velvet Ledger doesn't do that for tourists.

club_security_sasha_felt.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_felt.text: Dante flips an ace when he likes your call. Chin tip included.

club_security_sasha_challenge.speaker: Sasha
club_security_sasha_challenge.text: Hey — phones face-down. The Velvet Ledger doesn't do encore selfies.
